description: Get the questions for ClinicalSwipe's family caregiver navigator: who is being cared for, their coverage, family doctor, what is going on, military service, money and state. Returns each question with its answer codes, plus the full resource catalog, each resource with its official source URL and the date it was checked. format "fhir" returns the FHIR R4 Questionnaire instead. Call this before caregiver_plan so the answers use the codes it lists.

format.description: "json" (default): plain questions and the catalog. "fhir": the FHIR R4 Questionnaire.

name: caregiver_questionnaire
